aiExplanation: This function determines whether two **rectangles overlap** by finding the intersection area between them. Each rectangle is represented as an array `[x1, y1, x2, y2]` where `(x1, y1)` is the bottom-left corner and `(x2, y2)` is the top-right corner. The code calculates the **potential overlap region** by taking the **maximum** of the left/bottom coordinates from both rectangles (this gives the innermost bottom-left corner) and the **minimum** of the right/top coordinates (this gives the innermost top-right corner). The rectangles overlap only if this intersection region has **positive width** and **positive height** — meaning the top-right corner of the intersection is actually above and to the right of the bottom-left corner, which would be impossible if there was no real overlap.
